name: LIC's New Jeevan Anand
line: Savings plus life cover that continues for life after maturity.

Death benefit higher than the basic sum assured

Death cover is smaller than a term plan for the same premium
Bonus rates can change over the years
warnings: Check that the annual premium does not exceed 10% of the sum assured, or the 10(10D) maturity exemption may be affected

name: LIC's Jeevan Azad
